According to the SlowMist Security Alert system, potential suspicious activities related to Tsuru have resulted in a loss of 138.78 ETH.

Tsuru was exploited on the Base chain on 10 May 2024 via a minting access control flaw in the TSURUWrapper contract. The attacker minted 167.2 million TSURU tokens and exchanged them for about 137.78 ETH (~$410,000), draining protocol liquidity. The onERC1155Received function of the TSURUWrapper contract lacked proper access control, allowing any caller to mint TSURU tokens with a valid token ID. This let the attacker mint unbacked tokens and extract protocol liquidity.
